sections.title: Turning an amenity into an adjective
sections.content: You already know the -s suffix that turns a noun into a "having X" adjective — vörös hajú, "red-haired". The same -s works perfectly for hotel amenities: klíma → klímás ("with air conditioning"), erkély → erkélyes ("with a balcony"), kilátás → kilátásos ("with a view"). Put the -s adjective straight in front of szoba, just like any other adjective.

items.english: I'd like a room with air conditioning.
Do you have a room with a balcony?

sections.content: This is the exact same -s you already use for vörös hajú ("red-haired") — it just as easily attaches to a room feature as to a person's hair. Learn the pattern once, and it works on almost any noun.
